bias_measurement: Frozen unbearded/bearded image skin sample medians near lower cheeks/chin; one constant for the whole beard, not local repaint.
formula: Within generated support, estimate a=(Y(B)-Y(C))/(Y(B)-80/255), recover F=(C-(1-a)B)/a. Transparent skin and lip opening excluded; only observed approved dark pigment retained.
limitations: Estimated skin background gives source-faithful hair matting, not a claim of pixel-identical whole portrait or exact hair opacity.
method: Foreground matting during Godot asset import, restricted to the image_gen beard support. No procedural hair drawing.
